study_role: Paired carrier-only paraphrase extension of frozen SentinelRAG and RAVET
constraints: Paraphrase sentinel carrier documents only; ordinary and calibration documents remain unchanged
Use one meaning-preserving instruction for both methods, without probes, expected answers, method names or ownership labels
Freeze carrier identities, source corpus, probes, profiles and owner clusters before target execution
Do not reuse the old contract-aware NFCorpus paraphrase pilot as current RAVET evidence
Preserve every attempt; reject only malformed or unchanged transformations before any target outcome is available
Audit source/paraphrase fidelity independently; do not exclude transformations according to test outcomes
Reindex transformed carrier documents with unchanged ordinary documents using the pinned retrievers
Calibrate a common background bound from evaluation-disjoint unchanged clean documents using the predeclared procedure
Reuse an archived answer only when the entire model/prompt/argument request key matches exactly
Report cumulative first-crossing VSR and capped MQ, not fixed-endpoint binomial success
Average random-order seeds within deployments; eight paired deployments are not twenty-four independent deployments
This is a carrier-only paraphrase robustness study, not evidence for whole-corpus paraphrasing or targeted removal
